summary: Gravel/MTB/Running ride modes are now fully functional end-to-end. Backend `activity` filter on GET /api/scenic/routes works exactly to spec (3 gravel + 3 mtb + 3 running seeded, cycling filter excludes them). Frontend: today-mode-option-gravel/mountain-bike/running each SELECT the experience directly (no /coming-soon detour), Today renders the per-activity hero with correct descriptor + CTA + 3 routes, begin-scenic-journey opens /scenic-ride with the right route id. Regressions clean: scenic-cycling still shows the cycling catalog with no activity-route leaks; walking still routes to /coming-soon.
action_items: OPTIONAL/minor: the review request mentioned `future-activity-walking` testID should be visible when selecting walking. Today walking correctly navigates to /coming-soon?mode=walking (separate route) so the FutureActivityTodayView (and its `future-activity-walking` testID) is NOT rendered there — only when experience is walking rendered inline. The functional behaviour (coming-soon preview shown) is correct; consider adding a testID like `coming-soon-walking` on /app/frontend/app/coming-soon.tsx if the intent is to assert the walking preview by testID.
critical_code_review_comments: scenic.py list_scenic_routes cycling branch uses $or including missing/None/'' activity — correct backwards-compat for legacy rows.
seed_activity_routes is idempotent by id (find_one before insert) — safe on restart.
ScenicCyclingTodayView receives `activity` prop and drives useScenicRoutes(activity) + FRAMING lookup — clean.
scenic-destinations.tsx reads ?activity= via useLocalSearchParams and picks the correct title from titleMap — works for gravel/mtb/running/cycling.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing seeded demo@roujaune.app / demo9900 and the seed_activity_routes() 9 rows already inserted on backend startup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend requires auth on /api/scenic/routes. Use demo@roujaune.app/demo9900 to obtain a token via POST /api/auth/login. Seeded activity route ids: gravel-tuscany-strade, gravel-forest-fireroad, gravel-lakeside-mixed, mtb-alpine-singletrack, mtb-forest-flow, mtb-mountain-epic, run-coastal-promenade, run-park-loop, run-lakeside-trail. Frontend flow to select an experience: click [data-testid=today-mode-button] then [data-testid=today-mode-option-<id>] via JS-click; verify URL stays on / (not /coming-soon) for available modes.
rca_of_issue: N/A — feature added correctly, no bugs found.
